Session date: 4:30 pm on 9 April, 2023
[D12:1] Deborah: Hey Jolene! Great to see you! Had a blast biking nearby with my neighbor last week - was so freeing and beautiful. Checked out an art show with a friend today - really cool and inspiring stuff. Reminded me of my mom.
[D12:1] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a large brown and white photo of a person
[D12:2] Jolene: Hey Deborah! Sounds like you had a blast biking and at the art show. Your photo looks like you were really into it! Did it make you think profound thoughts?
[D12:3] Deborah: My mom was interested in art. She believed art could give out strong emotions and uniquely connect us. When I go to an art show, it's like we're still experiencing it together even though she's gone. It's hard but comforting.
[D12:4] Jolene: Losing someone is hard, but finding something that helps you cope is great.
[D12:5] Deborah: Finding ways to keep her memory alive gives me peace. It's amazing how something simple like artwork can bring back powerful emotions and remind us of those we've lost. It's about finding solace in the things we love, and art has done that for me.
[D12:6] Jolene: Even though my snakes can't chat or understand what I'm going through, our time together is valuable and teaches me to take time and be in tune with myself. Similarly, playing video games with my partner after a long day is a great way for me to relax.
[D12:7] Deborah: Simple things can indeed bring us the most happiness. How have these activities helped you during tough times?
[D12:8] Jolene: It brings us closer together!
[D12:9] Deborah: This kind of comfort can be really helpful when times get tough.
[D12:10] Jolene: Just so you know, I've been working on a big project lately - it's been tough but also really cool to watch it take shape. Can't wait to see the final result!
[D12:11] Deborah: I am waiting to hear how everything turns out. Keep up the good work!
[D12:12] Jolene: Thanks Deb! Your support means a lot. I'll keep you updated on the progress of the project.
[D12:13] Deborah: Glad my support means a lot to you! I'll always be here for you. 
[D12:14] Jolene: Take care!
[D12:15] Deborah: Enjoy your day and make time for the things that bring you joy. See ya!
[D12:16] Jolene:  I'll make sure to find time for that. Have a good one!

Session date: 9:48 am on 4 February, 2023
[D4:1] Jolene: Hey Deborah! Good to hear from you. How've you been? I've been on an emotional rollercoaster lately, but I'm coping.
[D4:2] Deborah: Hey Jolene! Good to hear from you. All good here - how about you? Anything new happening lately?
[D4:3] Jolene: I had a major milestone last week and it went really well - I'm so relieved and proud. It was a huge accomplishment for me as an engineer.
[D4:4] Deborah: That's awesome. You must have worked really hard for that. I'm so proud of you. Care to share more about it?
[D4:5] Jolene: Thanks so much! I had to plan and research a lot to design and build a sustainable water purifier for a rural community in need. It was tough, but I loved the experience.
[D4:6] Deborah: Your engineering skills really made a difference for people in a rural area. That's amazing! How did it feel when you saw it working?
[D4:7] Jolene: It was such a surreal moment. Seeing it working and providing clean water to the community was incredibly satisfying. It reminded me of how engineering can make a difference in people's lives. It made me feel like I had a purpose and had done something good.
[D4:8] Deborah: So, what are your career aspirations now?
[D4:9] Jolene:  I want to keep working in engineering and continue to make a positive impact on communities in need by creating sustainable solutions. My goal is to contribute towards making the world a better place with my work.
[D4:10] Deborah:  I'm sure great things will keep coming your way. Keep up the good work and follow your passions!
[D4:11] Jolene: Your support means a lot. I'm determined to keep going and make a difference. Your encouragement really motivates me to pursue my passions.
[D4:12] Deborah: When things get tough, just take a deep breath and remember why you're doing this. This is where I spend a lot of my time, teaching yoga. It's a great way to find balance and reconnect with ourselves. I bonded with Anna during yesterday's l yoga class.
[D4:12] Image caption (automatic): a photo of two women in a dance studio doing a dance pose
[D4:13] Jolene: Wow, that's awesome! What new poses did you try?
[D4:14] Deborah: We were trying out different dance poses, like Warrior II, which builds strength and boosts focus.
[D4:14] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a woman doing a yoga pose on a chair
[D4:15] Jolene: Is it difficult to do?
[D4:16] Deborah: Yes, but this brought us closer to Anna! We supported each other, that means a lot.
[D4:17] Jolene: Can you explain how to do it?
[D4:18] Deborah: Sure! To do this modified pose, sit on the edge of a chair with your feet planted. Twist your torso to one side and use your hand on your knee for support. You'll feel a stretch in your back and shoulders as you hold it for a few breaths, then switch sides. It's great for relaxing tense muscles.
[D4:19] Jolene: Sounds really hard! Here's my bookshelf!
[D4:19] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a book shelf with a lot of books on it
[D4:20] Deborah: That's quite a collection! Have you had a favorite book lately? I'd love to hear your thoughts.
[D4:21] Jolene: Thanks Deborah! I'm really into this book called "Sapiens" - it's a fascinating look at human history and how technology has affected us. It's giving me a lot to think about!
[D4:22] Deborah: Great, this is interesting! Have you come across any recent ones that really struck you?
[D4:23] Jolene: Two weeks ago I read "Avalanche" by Neal Stephenson in one sitting! 
[D4:24] Deborah: That sounds cool, Jolene. Stories can be so powerful - they can teach us, motivate us, and bring us together. 
[D4:25] Jolene: I also read a recent story about someone who became successful despite facing numerous challenges. It really showed me that anything is possible if you believe and work hard.
[D4:26] Deborah: That's a really powerful message. It reminds me of someone special and their grace and strength when they faced hardships. Check out this creation!
[D4:26] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a bouquet of flowers in a vase on a table
[D4:27] Jolene: Wow, Deb! That's beautiful! Can you tell me the backstory of that bouquet?
[D4:28] Deborah: My friend gave me this bouquet when I was struggling, and it gives me hope and courage. I'm filled with warmth and appreciation when I look at it.
[D4:29] Jolene: That's really sweet. Such a small thing can make a real difference.
[D4:30] Deborah: It's amazing how something as simple as flowers can make a real difference. Nature sure is beautiful.
[D4:31] Jolene: Where are some of your favorite nature spots?
[D4:32] Deborah: Oh, there's so many great places! My favorite is a park with a forest trail - it's so calming getting lost in nature. Then there's this beach nearby that I love - the sound of the waves and the sand under my feet make me feel all peaceful and happy. Do you have any favorite spots, Jolene?
[D4:33] Jolene: Here's a picture I took on vacation last summer in Bogota. It was so beautiful and calming watching the sunset over the water. It definitely made me appreciate nature's calming power.
[D4:33] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a person walking on the beach with a surfboard
[D4:34] Deborah: That sounds great, Jolene. Nature's calming for sure. Guess it helps us forget the daily craziness and find inner peace. No wonder you're a fan! I like to come to this spot by the water near my mom's old house. It's where I reflect on her life and find some peace. Being surrounded by nature helps a lot.
[D4:34] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a small island with a lone boat in the water
[D4:35] Jolene: That's so touching! Do you have any little traditions that you do when you come to reflect on your mom?
[D4:36] Deborah: Do you remember this amulet from her? Whenever I come here, I bring it with me. It's how I feel her love and stay close to her. Holding it brings me comfort.
[D4:36] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a woman wearing a white shirt and a gold chain necklace
[D4:37] Jolene: It's amazing how something so small can have such a big impact, huh?
[D4:38] Deborah: Yeah, even small things like this can make a big difference. It's a reminder of all the love and strength we have inside, connecting us to people we've lost and comforting us.
[D4:39] Jolene: It can keep them close in our hearts every day.
[D4:40] Deborah: Anna also has a pendant that she wears in memory of her mother! This also brought us closer.
[D4:41] Jolene: It's nice to have those reminders as a source of strength when we need it.

Session date: 2:14 pm on 3 September, 2023
[D24:1] Deborah: Hey Jolene, just catching up. I went to a cool event last week with the aim to support each other - pretty inspiring. Have you been connecting with anyone lately?

[D20:18] Deborah: What's your favorite yoga pose for some rest?
[D20:19] Jolene: I'm a fan of savasana - aka the corpse pose. It's so calming and helps me just let go and surrender.
[D20:19] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a person laying on the floor with a paper bag
[D20:20] Deborah: Funny photo! How long have you been doing yoga?
[D20:21] Jolene: Been doing it for 3 years. It's a great way to escape studying and work stress.
[D20:22] Deborah: Wow, Jolene! Taking time to unwind is key and that seems just right for you!
[D20:23] Jolene: I'm really finding my zen again!
[D20:24] Deborah: Keep it up!
[D20:25] Jolene: Thanks for your support, Deb! 
[D20:26] Deborah: Good luck with everything. Stay in touch.
Session date: 9:34 am on 24 August, 2023
[D21:1] Deborah: Hey Jolene! Good to hear from you! A lot's happened since we talked - last week I got to go to this yoga retreat near my mom's place. It was so cool - I got to hang with nature and really get to know myself. Definitely life-changing! That's how beautiful it was there!
[D21:1] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a trail in a forest with moss and trees
[D21:2] Jolene: Wow, Deb, sounds great! Glad you got to connect with yourself and nature. That's my own way to relax. What are your thoughts on life now?
[D21:2] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a man bending over on a blanket in the grass
[D21:3] Deborah: Life's been super meaningful lately. Nature and self-reflection have helped me see how beautiful every moment is. We can really grow and learn when we listen to ourselves. What's been up with you lately? Any insights or experiences?

[D21:3] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a mountain range with a colorful sunset in the background
[D21:4] Jolene: Life's been hectic, but I'm making strides toward my goals. It's tough, but satisfying.
[D21:5] Deborah: Can you tell me a bit more about it and what you've achieved?

passages.text:
Session date: 7:37 pm on 9 July, 2023
[D15:4] Jolene: Deborah, that's awesome! Being part of a supportive group must be super motivating. Finding a team that's passionate about something makes a huge difference. Just thinking about my own journey too.
[D15:5] Deborah: Having people who can cheer you on and give you advice really makes a difference. What has it been like for you finding supportive folks?
[D15:6] Jolene: Gaming's been tough lately, but I'm grateful I have someone who's also into it. My partner helps me stay focused on our goals. We have a lot of cute photos, I want to share with you.
[D15:6] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a man and a woman sitting in a chair in front of a computer
[D15:7] Deborah:  What do you like best about gaming together?
[D15:8] Jolene: We get to tackle challenges and have a shared experience. It's always a blast when we're into the same game and achieve something tough. Plus, it's a great way to bond and get closer.
[D15:9] Deborah: Woah, that's cool! Gaming is so good for strengthening relationships. Do you two have a favorite game to play together?
[D15:10] Jolene: Yeah, we love playing "It takes two" together! It's a fun team-strategy game and it's competitive. Plus, it's a great way for us to bond. Do you have any activities you like doing with people?
[D15:11] Deborah: Yep, I do running and yoga/meditation with others. Connecting with people and creating a community is great. Plus, I love organizing workshops and events to practice mindfulness and self-care. It's an awesome way to have fun, build relationships, and support each other's growth.
[D15:11] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a group of people doing yoga in a park
[D15:12] Jolene: Sounds like a great way to relax. What do your workshops and events involve?
[D15:13] Deborah: It involves various activities such as yoga, meditation, and self-reflection. They aim to cultivate self-awareness, promote mental and emotional well-being, and help individuals find inner peace. It's a space where people can connect, explore, and grow.
[D15:14] Jolene:  Your events are awesome for helping people connect and learn, it is so important. How has everything been going for you?
[D15:15] Deborah: Thanks, Jolene! It's been great seeing everyone come together and support each other. It's amazing to witness the growth and transformation that happens through these workshops. I'm honored to be a part of it.
[D15:15] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a game board with a bunch of cards on it
[D15:16] Jolene: Wow, Deb! I can imagine how rewarding it must be to create a space for growth and change. It's great to hear that everything's going well. You can always count on me for support! I just want to share a photo with you.
[D15:16] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a snake on a branch with a book
[D15:17] Deborah: Thanks, Jolene! Your support means a lot to me. I'm here for you too. By the way, I noticed your pet in the picture. What made you decide to get a snake?
[D15:18] Jolene:  I was fascinated by reptiles, and it felt like the perfect pet for me. Taking care of it has been really calming, and it's a great way to connect with nature.
[D15:19] Deborah:  Glad you found something that gives you peace and calm. Do you have a favorite memory with "it" to share?
[D15:20] Jolene: I have lots of great memories, like our little 'snake adventure'. She got out and I spent hours searching, so relieved when I finally found her snuggling under the bed. It really showed how much I love her.
[D15:20] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a snake in a tank with sand and plants
[D15:21] Deborah: What was it like when you found her? I can imagine the relief!
[D15:22] Jolene: Seeing her snuggled under the bed made me feel so much love and gratitude. It made me realize how important she is to me.
[D15:23] Deborah: They bring so much joy and remind us of what's important.
[D15:24] Jolene: Animals teach us a lot about love and gratitude, and they bring so much joy. 
[D15:25] Deborah: I haven't introduced you to my pets yet! I don't like dogs, that's why I have cats.
[D15:25] Image caption (automatic): a photography of two cats sitting on a couch with a blanket
[D15:26] Jolene: Looks like they're having a blast! How often do you take them out?
[D15:27] Deborah: Exercise and nature are really important to me, so I make sure to take them out for a run in the park every morning and evening.
[D15:27] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a person walking on the beach with a surfboard
[D15:28] Jolene: Wow Deb, that's great! I'd love to experience that every day.
[D15:29] Deborah: Nature helps me find peace every day - it's so refreshing!
[D15:30] Jolene: It's a pity that my snakes don't run!  I'd love to do that more often. They would motivate me and together it would be more fun.
[D15:30] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a person walking on the beach with a surfboard
[D15:31] Deborah:  It's like hitting a reset button that helps me put things into perspective and gives me time to reflect.
[D15:32] Jolene: Yeah, I totally get it. Whenever I can, I love going for walks to take it all in. And I take photos like this
[D15:32] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a sunset over a body of water
[D15:33] Deborah: It's amazing how nature has the power to bring us peace and clarity.
[D15:34] Jolene: This photo captures the peacefulness of a lake surrounded by trees.
[D15:34] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a dock on a lake with trees in the background
[D15:35] Deborah: Why did you choose that spot? It looks so calm.
[D15:36] Jolene: It's such a hidden gem! It makes me feel so peaceful and tranquil.
[D15:37] Deborah: Lucky you for having somewhere to relax and tune out!
[D15:38] Jolene: We'll definitely go there together sometime!
[D15:39] Deborah: We all need a timeout!
Session date: 9:26 am on 1 August, 2023
[D16:1] Deborah: Hey Jolene! Great news - I just started a project for a cleanup in our community and have been trying to raise funds for it. It's been amazing to see everyone come together to make a difference. How've you been? Anything new going on?
[D16:2] Jolene: Hey Debs! Congrats on your project for the community! As for me, life's been a rollercoaster lately. Last week, I had a huge setback with my project. I put in so much work and it all crashed and I lost everything. SO frustrating and depressing.
[D16:3] Deborah: Jolene, sorry to hear that. It must be really tough. I'm here for you and if I can do anything, just let me know. Is there anything that's helping you cope?
[D16:4] Jolene: Your support means a lot. Susie really helps when times get tough. Pets have been great company. Video games have also been a nice distraction.
[D16:4] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a man holding a snake on his arm
[D16:5] Deborah: They can really provide love and comfort, especially during tough times. How did you come to have Susie?
[D16:6] Jolene: I adopted her two years ago when I was feeling lonely and wanted some company.
[D16:7] Deborah: That's great, Jolene! Animals sure have a way of bringing us happiness. They understand us and provide us with comfort. Plus, having a pet teaches us responsibility. She came at the perfect time - cherish those moments with her and find strength in her presence.
[D16:8] Jolene: Thanks Deborah. Having her around shows me I can stay strong and find joy in the small stuff.
[D16:9] Deborah: Enjoying the little things is key. Those little moments can give us a boost and push us forward. How have you been taking care of yourself lately?
